dimensions.name: Liability & Indemnity
dimensions.description: Assess liability caps, indemnity scope, and exclusions.
signals: no carve-outs for gross negligence or willful misconduct
dimensions.recommendation: Negotiate a mutually acceptable liability cap and limit indemnity to third-party IP, confidentiality, and data breaches.

dimensions.name: Termination
dimensions.description: Review termination for convenience, notice periods, and cure rights.
signals: termination for convenience with short notice
no return or destruction obligations upon termination
dimensions.recommendation: Add a reasonable cure period and clarify post-termination obligations.

dimensions.name: Payment Terms
dimensions.description: Evaluate invoicing, milestones, late payment, and currency terms.
dimensions.recommendation: Shorten payment terms, tie payments to milestones, and add late interest.

dimensions.name: Intellectual Property
dimensions.description: Check IP ownership, license grants, and background IP.
dimensions.recommendation: Clarify ownership of deliverables, retain background IP, and grant narrow licenses.

dimensions.name: Data Protection
dimensions.description: Review personal data handling, cross-border transfers, and security.
dimensions.recommendation: Add a DPA, specify lawful basis, and include standard contractual clauses for transfers.

dimensions.name: Confidentiality
dimensions.description: Assess NDA scope, exceptions, and survival period.
signals: overly broad definition of confidential information
dimensions.recommendation: Limit survival to a reasonable period and narrow the definition of confidential information.

dimensions.name: Non-compete / Exclusivity
dimensions.description: Evaluate non-compete, exclusivity, and non-solicit clauses.
dimensions.recommendation: Narrow scope, duration, and geography to what is reasonably necessary.

dimensions.name: Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
dimensions.description: Review choice of law, venue, and dispute resolution.
dimensions.recommendation: Select neutral governing law and a convenient dispute resolution forum.
